description: P-I: collects the channels of up to eight cables into one list for the P-O module beside it to hand back out; it goes to the left of P-O

inputs.text: One cable whose channels are added to the list, in port order; an unpatched port contributes one channel at 0V

notes: this module does nothing on its own: a P-O module must be placed directly to its right, and the lamp at the top turns green when they are joined
more P-I modules can be chained to the left to add further inputs, and they are read from the joined pair outwards
the display beside a port shows how many channels that cable is carrying
